title: Price Filter
description: Filter products by price range. Either bound is optional; specifying both narrows to the inclusive [min, max] range.

min.description: Inclusive lower bound for the product's price, in ISO 4217 minor units.

max.description: Inclusive upper bound for the product's price, in ISO 4217 minor units.

currency.description: ISO 4217 currency code (e.g., 'USD', 'EUR', 'GBP'). When omitted, the merchant's default currency is assumed.
